r0.changes: Baseline: GOC definition + edge-case rules; few-shot adds 3 synthetic examples (direct yes, secondhand yes, hard no: planned meeting).

r1.changes: From dev triage (CMO status lines; planned meeting + family update): CMO / comfort orders join the code-status rule; planned meeting with a family update -> no, real conversation + follow-up -> yes; must find the sentence describing the conversation, and evidence_span must be that sentence; 4th few-shot example (hard no: CMO + update + planned meeting).

r2.changes: User-written system prompt: two tests, (A) a conversation with the patient/family/HCP already happened, or they made an overall-direction decision (CMO, withdrawal, hospice, stop chemo), and (B) it has content (goals, values, prognosis shared, or a treatment preference/decision); 9 always-no patterns (code status, empty templates, planned talks, updates, team plans/consults, content-free meetings, medical management, comfort orders, stated preferences + referral), 3 yes patterns, a 4-step procedure; evidence_span must pass A and B. Few-shot: 16 synthetic examples (6 yes, 10 no), replacing the 4. num_ctx 12288 -> 16384 from r2 on, so every test note fits under few-shot.
